create_vgg_block: create a VGG block with configurable channels, kernel size, batchnorm, and ReLU activation
build_vgg_backbone: build a VGG backbone model with configurable input channels, batchnorm, max pooling, and padding
create_parametric_vgg: create a parametric VGG backbone with custom normalization functions and channel configuration
build_parametric_vgg_block: build a parametric VGG block with configurable channels, kernel size, normalization function, and ReLU activation
test_vgg_mappings: test the coordinate mappings of a VGG or ParametricVGG backbone model
